title: unified rollouts: canary/shadow auto-rollback workflows and stability guards
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Adds new canary+shadow auto-rollback workflow and stability guards; no public API changes. Operators can enable progressive canary, shaded shadow probing, and metric-based auto rollback via rollout policy config.
description:
Motivation: We need a single, maintainable workflow for progressive canary + shadow deployments that supports automated rollback based on composite metrics and stability guards. This unifies previous ad-hoc scripts and multiple controller paths into one policy-driven engine.

What changed: Implemented a new RolloutPolicy engine and workflow templates (canary, shadow-probing, AB) that support: progressive weight adjustments, shadow probing probes with quarantine/quorum semantics, composite metric evaluation, and automated rollback when thresholds are exceeded. Added stability guards to avoid flapping: min-stable-window, consecutive-failure-threshold, and quarantine stage that pauses traffic until probes recover.

Behavioral summary: Default policy is a staged canary with a shadow probe running against a mirror of traffic for quality checks. If composite metric (latency P99, error-rate, and quality regression score) exceeds configured thresholds during a stage, policy marks the stage as failed and triggers an automated rollback to the previous pinned model. Operators can configure weighted canaries and can run shadow-only probes for non-disruptive validation.

Rollout config changes: New schema under rollouts/v1/Policy with the following keys (high level): stages[], probe{type, sample_rate, quarantine, quorum}, metrics{composite, thresholds}, stabilityGuards{minStableWindow, consecutiveFailureThreshold}. All existing rollout configs are backward compatible; controllers fall back to legacy behavior if policy key absent.

Testing & e2e: Added unit tests for policy evaluation and metric aggregation; added e2e tests that run a 3-stage canary with shadow probes and validate rollback behavior in failure scenarios. One flaky e2e was stabilized by increasing mock probe timeouts.

Observability: New telemetry: rollout.stage_duration, rollout.probe_quarantine_count, rollout.auto_rollback_trigger{metric,threshold,value}, rollout.stability_guard_events. Dashboards updated under observability/rollouts to include per-model SLO breakdown and rollback histogram.

Migration: No automated migration required. Operators who want the new engine can opt-in by adding a rolloutPolicy: "v1" block to their rollout manifest. Backward compatibility checks in controller will emit a deprecation warning when legacy configs are used (logged at INFO).

Rollout plan: Feature-flag gated. Enabled behind feature.rollouts.v2. Initial rollout to internal staging followed by limited customer pilot (Dedicated customers) before broader release.

Related: ENG-4821 (unified rollback engine), ENG-4838 (observability for rollouts), SUP-1289 (customer report of unstable canary behavior).

changelog_entry: rollouts: add unified policy-driven canary and shadow auto-rollback workflows with stability guards and observability
notes_for_ops: Enable via feature flag feature.rollouts.v2 in helm values. Recommended default policy for pilot: 3-stage canary, shadow_probe sample_rate=0.05, composite thresholds: p99>500ms OR error_rate>0.5% OR quality_regression>2% triggers rollback. Monitor rollout.auto_rollback_trigger metric.
test_plan: Unit tests + e2e staged canary test included. Manual validation in staging: run example manifests in docs/rollouts and observe rollback behavior under synthetic failures.
notes: This PR consolidates several internal rollout workflows into a single policy engine to reduce complexity and fix observed flapping behavior in canary rollouts.
